fields.description: Operator label, also the record name.
fields.label: Title
Enabled
fields.description: Turn this sync on or off without deleting it.

fields.label: Document Type
fields.description: The ERPNext record type to sync, e.g. Customer, Item, Sales Order.

fields.label: Medusa Entity
fields.description: What this doctype is called on the Medusa side: customer, product, order, and so on. Used to pair the two copies of this mapping.

fields.label: Site
fields.description: Limit this mapping to one Medusa site. Leave blank to apply it to every connected site.
To Medusa = this site pushes changes out. From Medusa = Medusa writes in. Two-way = both.
fields.label: Direction
Source of Truth
fields.description: Which side wins when the same record changed on both. ERPNext by default.
Event name Medusa receives, e.g. customer.updated. Blank derives one from the doctype and docevent.
fields.label: Medusa Event Name

fields.description: One Frappe document event per line: after_insert, on_update, on_submit, on_cancel, on_trash, on_update_after_submit.
fields.label: Trigger On

fields.description: Optional Python expression evaluated against `doc`. Blank = always fire. e.g. doc.customer_group == "Retail"
fields.label: Condition

fields.description: Send every field on the document instead of only the mapped ones. Convenient for a first run; prefer an explicit list once you know what Medusa needs.
fields.label: Send All Fields
Skip When Nothing Changed
fields.description: Do not send when the payload is identical to the last one that succeeded for this document. Only mapped fields count, so an unrelated edit elsewhere on the doc will not re-send.
Field whose value identifies this record on the Medusa side.
fields.label: Key Field
Medusa May Create Records
fields.description: Let Medusa create new records here when it sends one it hasn't seen before.

fields.label: Medusa May Update Records
fields.description: Let Medusa update existing records here when they change on its side.
Off by default on purpose — a delete arriving over HTTP is rarely what you want.
fields.label: Medusa May Delete Records

fields.description: Submit submittable documents right after Medusa creates them.
fields.label: Submit On Insert
Identity
fields.description: Set automatically. Both systems hold the same mapping under this id; the higher version wins when they disagree, and ERPNext wins a tie.

fields.label: Rehearsal
fields.description: A mapping goes live only after somebody has seen it work. Use Test in the toolbar: it shows what would be sent and what an arriving payload would do, writes nothing, and switches the mapping on if it held up.

fields.label: Rehearsed Signature
fields.description: Fingerprint of what this mapping does — doctype, direction, key and field map. Changing any of those means the rehearsal no longer describes it; changing the title or ticking Enabled does not.
